description: Furtim Modus | Hiring Java Developer (Full-Time) | NYC (HYBRID) | $150K-$300K + equity | https://www.furtimmodus.com/software-engineer We are seeking a talented and driven Java Developer to join our team full-time. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute your skills and expertise to help build high-performance technology for a U.S. equities trading venue focused on NMS stocks based out of the New York City and in exchange we’ll provide you with base comp $150k-$300k, full benefits, cash bonus, and equity. The primary focus of this role is developing reliable, low-latency trading infrastructure, including order processing, matching, market data, and connectivity. You will work closely with our engineering and business teams to solve technical challenges and contribute directly to the development of our trading platform. Required Qualifications: - Experience developing server-side software for U.S. equities electronic trading systems. - Strong low-latency programming experience using Core Java 17 or later, including concurrency, memory management, and JVM performance optimization. - Strong understanding of data structures and caching strategies, including sets, maps, hash tables, and caches. - Understanding of electronic trading order lifecycles, including new orders, acknowledgments, executions, cancellations, and cancel/replace requests. - Experience with dependency injection, inversion of control, and event-driven architecture. - Experience developing and maintaining automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. - Experience working in an Agile development environment. - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. - Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Highly Preferred: - Experience with open-source technologies Aeron Transport, Aeron Cluster, Aeron Archive, Artio, and Agrona. - Experience developing technology for an ATS, exchange, matching engine, or broker-dealer execution platform. - Experience with FIX connectivity, particularly FIX 4.2, including session management, order messaging, and recovery. - Experience with deterministic event processing, persistence, replay, high availability, and failover in trading systems. - Experience with Web3 or blockchain applications involving tokenized equities or other tokenized securities, including issuance, transfer controls, custody connectivity, or reconciliation with securities records. Additional Preferred Qualifications: - Knowledge of microservices architecture. - Experience with the Adaptive Hydra trading platform. - Experience with AWS services, particularly EC2 and S3. - Experience with Linux or Unix environments and shell scripting. - Experience with development and collaboration tools such as GitHub, Jira, Confluence. - Experience integrating Java backend services with blockchain networks, smart contracts, or institutional digital asset platforms. - Familiarity with blockchain transaction processing and event monitoring, including transaction submission, confirmations, retries, duplicate handling, and recovery. Benefits: - Competitive base salary, cash bonus, equity, and full benefits. - Flexible hybrid schedule. - Collaborative and supportive team environment. - Relocation assistance to the NYC metropolitan area. Process: We keep our interview process focused, practical, and respectful of your time. - Introductory conversation: Virtual discussion with a co-founder about your background, interests, and the role. - Programming interview: Virtual technical interviews with a programming exercise relevant to the position. - Engineering discussion: Virtual conversation with engineering colleague about your experience, technical decisions, and approach to building reliable trading systems. If you are passionate about Java development and U.S. equities trading technology, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume if interested to agency@furtimmodus.com in this opportunity.
